card.name: Restriction phrases before 'unless' or 'without'
card.fires_on: The last word of a 'should not be used/given/reproduced' style restriction, right where 'unless', 'except' or 'without' would come next. Common after 'women of childbearing' and in copyright notices.

modes.label: Pregnancy warnings
modes.description: End of a 'should not be used in women of childbearing potential' clause, before 'unless' or 'until'.
modes.example: valproate should not be administered to a woman of childbearing<< potential>> unless other medications have failed to provide adequate

modes.label: Copyright and permission wording
modes.description: End of a clause that bars copying or reuse, before 'without permission' or 'in any format'.
modes.example: may not be<< reproduced>> without permission.

modes.label: Dependence on something
modes.description: A verb followed by a likely 'without' in a general sentence.
modes.example: it can’t<< happen>> without its volunteers

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with 'without' as the next word.
card.plain: It fires where a sentence has just set a restriction and is about to add 'without' or an exception.
